fields.summary_ko.0: ASML is the sole supplier of EUV lithography systems with 12-month revenue of $43.4 billion (22.5% increase year-over-year), net income of $14.8 billion, and net margin of 34.1%, possessing a high-margin business model.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix achieved 12-month revenue of $201.2 billion (219.8% increase year-over-year), net income of $141.4 billion, and net margin of 70.3%, benefiting from AI memory premium pricing to achieve ultra-high margins.
fields.summary_ko.2: Compared to ASML's debt-to-capital ratio of 0.2x and current ratio of 1.3x, SK Hynix has a debt-to-capital ratio of 0.2x and current ratio of 1.9x, demonstrating a healthier short-term liquidity position.
